===== src/components/Button.tsx
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's component. Edit the design and export again, or take it over.
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { IconCheck } from "./IconCheck";
import styles from "./Button.module.css";
import { cx } from "../cx";

export interface ButtonProps {
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  state?: "default" | "hover" | "disabled";
  label?: string;
  icon?: ReactNode;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

const VARIANTS: Record<string, string> = {
  "sm/default": "md-default",
  "sm/hover": "md-default",
  "sm/disabled": "md-default",
  "md/default": "md-default",
  "md/hover": "md-default",
  "md/disabled": "md-default",
  "lg/default": "lg-default",
  "lg/hover": "lg-default",
  "lg/disabled": "lg-default",
};

export function Button({ size = "md", state = "default", label = "Button", icon = <IconCheck className={styles.icon} />, showIcon = false, children, className }: ButtonProps) {
  const variant = VARIANTS[`${size}/${state}`] ?? "md-default";
  switch (variant) {
    case "lg-default":
      return (
        <div className={cx(styles.root2, className)} data-variant={variant} />
      );
    default:
      return (
        <button className={cx(styles.root, className)} type="button" data-variant={variant}>
          {showIcon && icon}
          <span className={styles.label}>{label}</span>
        </button>
      );
  }
}

===== src/components/IconCheck.tsx
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's component. Edit the design and export again, or take it over.
import styles from "./IconCheck.module.css";
import { cx } from "../cx";

export interface IconCheckProps {
  className?: string;
}

export function IconCheck({ className }: IconCheckProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cx(styles.root, className)}>
      <svg className={styles.path} xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 8l4 4 8-8" fill="none" fillRule="evenodd" stroke="#18181b" strokeWidth="1.5" /></svg>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src/cx.ts
/** Joins class names, skipping empty ones. */
export function cx(...names: (string | false | null | undefined)[]) {
  return names.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}
